mainEntity.name: How does website optimization differ for local agencies compared to national brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: For local agencies, website optimization heavily emphasizes local SEO signals, such as Google My Business integration, local keyword targeting, and localized content. National brands, in contrast, focus on broader keyword strategies, larger-scale content marketing, and brand authority across diverse regions. While both require technical SEO and good user experience, the core difference lies in the geographic scope and audience targeting. Local optimization aims to dominate specific cities or neighborhoods, whereas national optimization seeks widespread recognition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local agency optimization prioritizes local SEO, Google My Business, and geographic content, while national brands focus on broader keywords and wider audience reach.
